standard-dialogue.npc: Those children are nothing but trouble - if I did not watch them all the time, Seren knows what trouble they would get in to!

standard-dialogue.player: They look old enough to look after themselves.

standard-dialogue.npc: They are only 34 and 38, far too young to be left unsupervised.

standard-dialogue.player: Only!?! How old does that make you?

standard-dialogue.npc: Has no one told you it is rude to ask a lady her age?

standard-dialogue.player: Sorry, I wasn't thinking. Anyway... I'd better stop distracting you.

standard-dialogue.npc: Okay, See you some other time.

overhead-dialogue-failed-pickpocket-atte.npc: What do you think you're doing?
